docs_dir: <this app's neuralos docs directory — the runtime fills the real path>

factory.about: Turn any data source into a neuralOS instance: the four-phase workflow (profile → model → generate → verify), source routing, runtime choice, operating rules, deliverables contract.

runtime.about: The on-device tool-calling model: surfaces (Python API, engine binary, PowerShell), install, quick start, the tool-design rules that make a 121M model reliable, troubleshooting table.

bootstrap.about: New-host setup: what the app already ships, the interpreter + instances root a host still needs, readiness smoke tests, offline/Windows/Intel-mac notes.

instance-standards.about: Hard rules for generated instances: triggers, constrained arguments, digest+stash results, secrets in executors, read-only first, verification.

graph-standards.about: The relationship layer: node/edge tiers, provenance, disjoint honesty, ≤3 graph probes, the graph verification gate.

pydantic-standards.about: Strict Pydantic v2 generation: type mapping, constraints from observed data, aliases, validators.

profiler.about: What profile_data.py measures, per source kind, and its limits.

sources-files.about: Files as sources: CSV/TSV, JSON/JSONL, logs, spreadsheets — edge cases and failure modes.

sources-databases.about: Databases as sources: DSNs, information_schema, enums, usql.

sources-apis.about: REST APIs as sources: fetching, sniffing, baked auth, endpoint probes.

sources-unstructured.about: Unstructured text: extraction schemas, templates, the structured-extraction path.

tool-design.about: Tool-design rules in depth with code patterns — read before debugging any misbehavior.

engine-binary.about: The standalone engine binary: CLI flags, JSON output contract, HTTP serve mode, platform matrix.

python-api.about: The Python API: @needle.tool, Needle.run, Field constraints, extraction, embeddings.

cli.about: The `needle run` CLI (needs jax) — when to prefer the engine binary instead.

powershell.about: Running the engine on PowerShell-only Windows hosts (no Python at runtime).

powershell-factory.about: BUILDING instances for PowerShell-only Windows hosts (build phases elsewhere, bridge.ps1 deployment).

troubleshooting.about: Expanded symptom table: wrong interpreter, ungrounded args, loops, refusals, charset issues.

decision-models.about: The laya decision model: typed choice/noul/score judgments offline, and when NOT to use it.

decision-model-integration.about: The measured laya-vs-engine pilot and the env-gated router wiring rules.
